build_browser_launch: launch a browser instance with custom headless, proxy, and slowMo settings
create_persistent_context: launch a persistent browser context with userDataDir, viewport, and geolocation options
connect_browser_cdp: connect to a browser over CDP using an endpoint URL and optional headers
connect_browser_websocket: connect to a pre-launched browser via WebSocket endpoint with timeout and exposeNetwork
normalize_launch_params: normalize launch parameters by converting env dicts, paths, and ignoreDefaultArgs flags
